title: The Silent Phones
scene: At 1:35 PM, the call center headset was smashed. Phones were down for a drill from 1:20 to 1:50.

suspects.name: Nate Cole
suspects.testimony: I was walking the floor at 1:35, checking stations.
suspects.alibiProof: The floor camera shows Nate at 1:33 and 1:39.

suspects.name: Olive Vale
suspects.testimony: I was at my desk at 1:35, reading policy.
suspects.alibiProof: The desk camera shows Olive at 1:34.

suspects.name: Quinn Reed
suspects.testimony: I was in the phone room at 1:35, restoring service.
suspects.contradiction: The phone room was locked for the drill, and headset pieces were in Quinn's bag.

suspects.name: Rosa Pike
suspects.testimony: I was in the break room at 1:35.
suspects.alibiProof: The break room log shows Rosa's badge at 1:32 and 1:41.
